tasks.title: Link Editing Behavior
tasks.description: Create LinkPopover.jsx component with URL input, text input, Save/Cancel buttons, and delete link option. Integrate with TipTap Link extension. Define click behavior to open popover, Ctrl+click to follow URL in new tab. Handle Enter/Escape keyboard. Position popover near link.
test_criteria: Links are clickable and open editor popover
Ctrl+click opens URL in new tab
Keyboard navigation works (Enter saves, Escape closes)
tasks.impl_notes: Integrate LinkPopover with TipTap Link extension. Test with various link formats (URL, relative, anchor).

tasks.title: Code Syntax Highlighting Integration
tasks.description: Verify CodeBlockHighlight.jsx component exists and works. Check backend highlight_code_block command implementation. Wire CodeBlockHighlight into TipTap code block node rendering. Ensure language detection works (js, ts, python, rust, etc.). Test highlighting renders correctly for fenced code blocks.
test_criteria: Code blocks render with syntax highlighting
tasks.impl_notes: Check backend highlight_code_block command in src-tauri/src/commands/editor.rs. Verify scroll behavior for long code blocks and dark/light theme compatibility.

tasks.title: Frontmatter UI Component
tasks.description: Create FrontmatterBlock.jsx component to detect frontmatter at document start (YAML --- delimited). Display as collapsible block with toggle. Apply syntax styling (key: value pairs). Parse and display metadata (title, tags, date, etc.). Handle missing/invalid frontmatter gracefully.
test_criteria: Frontmatter displays as styled collapsible block
tasks.impl_notes: Allow expand/collapse toggle. Display metadata in key: value format.

tasks.title: Ropey Buffer for Large Documents
